study: Mask-initialized fixed-group GGF at matched75x3 decoder capacity

recipe.scope: Capacity-matched task adaptation; reused inspected holdout.

protocol.only_change: Training-mask foreground SVD dictionary replaces random dictionary at update zero. Encoder is its transpose, bias zero, exactly the native tied-init convention.
protocol.schedule: 2500 reconstruction warm-up updates + 2500 guided updates; same ordered images and denoising RNG schedule as cached native-start GGF.
protocol.mapping: Both arms choose category training targets using the identical training-only mapping policy AFTER warm-up. Initial SVD category slots are not hard-wired into the loss.
protocol.checkpoint_rule: Warm-up: best development MSE. Guided: capture + 0.2 AP, guarded by common cached native warm-up MSE +2%, not by a weaker mask-start reconstruction floor.
protocol.initializer: All training-supported foreground patches, uncentered per-category second moment after frozen global normalization; no whitening, label-based test routing or new losses.
protocol.controls: Cached native-start GGF and continued reconstruction; identical numerical versions, device type and batch identities required. Reevaluated alongside new model.
protocol.scope: Small 75-group initialization diagnostic, not a replacement for the successful 1024-group result. Reused inspected holdout, not independent confirmation. SVD adds measured computation beyond matched gradient-update budget.

fit_recipe.scope: Capacity-matched task adaptation; reused inspected holdout.

confirmation.initializer: Same deterministic training-mask SVD for all starts; seeds vary shuffle and noise, not this initial dictionary.
confirmation.masks: Training-only foreground SVD and training group assignment; annotations never enter encode at inference.
confirmation.unchanged: 75 x 3, Top16, data, normalization, optimizer, denoising, losses, training target policy and common native reconstruction guard.
confirmation.historical_test: Same inspected1500-image holdout. New training trajectories on one dataset, not a new independent benchmark.
confirmation.primary: Mask-init vs native-init GGF within each seed. Capture/AP/VE must be read jointly.
confirmation.comparisons: Also show continued Vanilla, fitted SLiCS-mask and SVD-only. Preserve ineligible labels. This is our SLiCS-based adaptation, not published SLiCS.
confirmation.statistical_scope: Image intervals are conditional on fitted models; initialization is identical across mask runs. No seed-population/SOTA claim.
confirmation.interpretation: Replicate across new training orders before promoting initialization. This notebook does not test full1024-group capacity or structural AGF.
confirmation.follow_up: If confirmed, freeze the initialization recipe and then test its larger-capacity extension separately.

aggregate.note: SVD is a zero-update reference with unmatched gradient budget.
